这是“科研论文基本信息”模板。调用它时应该采用如下格式： 
{{科研论文基本信息
|Country=
|Affiliation=
|JournalIssue=
|JournalTitle=
|JounalTitleAbbr=
|JournalVolume=
|Language=
|PageNumber=
|PMCID=
|PubDate=
|PubTitle=
|PubYear=
|ISSN=
|PMID=
|Author=
}}

font-size: 14px;box-shadow: 0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);" |- style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:38px;" |colspan="2" | 期刊论文基本信息 {|- style="{{#ifeq:{{{PubTitle|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''PubTitle''' || [[论文发表名称::{{{PubTitle|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{Country|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''Country''' || [[论文发表国家::{{{Country|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{PubDate|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''PubDate''' || [[论文发表日期::{{{PubDate|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{PubYear|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''PubYear''' || [[论文发表年份::{{{PubYear|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{Language|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''Language''' || [[论文语种::{{{Language|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{JournalTitle|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''JournalTitle''' || [[期刊标题::{{{JournalTitle|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{JounalTitleAbbr|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''JounalTitleAbbr''' || [[期刊标题附加::{{{JounalTitleAbbr|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{JournalIssue|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''JournalIssue''' || [[期刊期号::{{{JournalIssue|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{JournalVolume|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''JournalVolume''' || [[期刊卷数::{{{JournalVolume|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{PageNumber|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''PageNumber''' || [[论文页数::{{{PageNumber|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{PMID|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''PMID''' || [[Pubmed的ID::{{{PMID|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{PMCID|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''PMCID''' || [[PMC为每一篇文献给予的特定编号::{{{PMCID|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{ISSN|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''ISSN''' || [[国际标准刊号::{{{ISSN|}}}]] |- style="{{#ifeq:{{{Author|}}}||display: none|}}" |style="width: 85pt;"| '''Author''' ||{{#arraymap:{{{Author|}}}|;|x| [[作者::x]]}} |}
